title: 昭和の雪あそび
subject_en: Showa-era retro winter play scenes with ONE or two children in old-fashioned knit hats, mittens and padded coats, each a small complete scene with a few props. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text.
lead: 雪だるま、かまくら、そり、おしくらまんじゅう。昭和の冬の子どもの遊び12場面。レトロなチラシやポスターに。
items: two children rolling a big snowball to make a snowman with a bucket hat
a child peeking out of a dome-shaped snow hut with a small candle inside
two children sliding down on a wooden sled
four children back to back pushing each other with red cheeks
two children throwing snowballs from behind small snow walls
a child pointing at long icicles hanging from a tiled roof edge
a child warming hands by a kerosene stove with a kettle on top
a child and a cat at a kotatsu with a bowl of tangerines
a child walking in fresh snow looking back at a trail of footprints
a child lying in snow making a snow angel with arms spread
a child holding a hot roasted sweet potato wrapped in paper with steam
a child ice skating with wobbly arms on a small frozen pond
